messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Incident detected: sustained increase in inference tail latency (streaming stalls) for the last 7m on prod-east. p95 spiked ~220ms -> 650ms, p99 jumped 1.9s -> 6.2s. Error count (stream stalls): +480 in 10m. Affected routes: /v1/chat/stream, /v1/generate (hosted & dedicated).

Alex G: getting paged, looking now. Do we have CA for customers? @CS-Bot list?

CS-Bot: Affected customers: BrightMarket (high traffic), AtlasHealth (dedicated), and a handful of small PLG apps. No major SLA breach reported yet but errors correlate with spikes.

Maria P: seeing concurrent DB connection spikes on config-store (config-service), CPU at 88%, connection pool exhaustion logs.

Samir K: adding infra metrics — redis and auth rate-limiter look fine. DB (config-store-primary) shows lots of short-lived connections from controlplane. Query latency p95=45ms, p99=1.2s.

Jen L: feature-flag rollout to 0.7 yesterday that changed config fetch path -> new code hits DB on every stream init. Suspect increased chattiness.

Alex G: can we toggle flag back to 0.6? Need emergency rollback plan.

Maria P: rolling back flag via flags-service now: 
```
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle -d '{flag: ff_stream_config_fetch, value: false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'
```

OpsBot: flag rollback started (req id: r-9a7f). Propagation ETA ~30s across controlplane.

Samir K: putting a short-term mitigation: enable local fetch cache on runtime nodes and increase config-service DB pool from 200 -> 600. Applying now.

Alex G: command to bump pool:
```
kubectl -n infra patch deployment config-store --patch '{spec:{template:{spec:{containers:[{name:config,env:[{name:DB_POOL_MAX,value:600}] }]}}}}'
```

Jen L: I can also push a small rate-limit at controlplane to reduce burstiness: throttle connection attempts from model-runtime to config-service to 50rps.

Samir K: applied throttle on envoy route, see filter log id=env-conn-throttle-341. Observing connection attempts drop.

Alex G: metrics updating — p95 down to 280ms, p99 2.1s, streaming stalls falling but still occuring at low rate.

Maria P: DB CPU trending down to 62%. New errors mostly from older nodes without new cache. Starting rolling restart of runtime nodes to pick up cache flag.

Alex G: rolling restart command (staggered):
```
for pod in $(kubectl -n runtime get pods -l app=llm-runtime -o name | shuf | tail -n +3); do kubectl -n runtime delete $pod; sleep 15; done
```

OpsBot: Restart job queued. Will restart ~50 nodes over 20m.

CS-Bot: customers notified: Brief intermittent stalls observed, root cause: config-service load after recent flag rollout. Mitigation in progress.

Samir K: after 8m restarts + rollback, p95=150ms, p99=420ms. Streaming stalls <1/minute. Error count down 92%.

Jen L: action item: revert rollout and schedule safe re-deploy with cache fallback + DB pool sizing. I'll open a follow-up PR for gating.

Alex G: creating incident ticket INC-2026-834 in tracker. Assigning to eng-runtime and eng-ml for postmortem.

Maria P: short postmortem checklist: timelines, feature flag decision, db sizing, autoscaling rules for config-service, add local cache default for streaming path.

Samir K: handoff to night oncall Samir K (me) — I'll monitor for 4 hours then hand off to Alex in morning. Current status: degraded -> stabilizing. Next steps: run query to find nodes without cache and redeploy.

Jen L: note for postmortem: include synthetic test that exercises config fetch under high-concurrency streaming.

Alex G: thanks all. If anything spikes, page 24/7 @oncall. Closing thread for now but will append notes to INC ticket.

IncidentBot: Incident resolved? status: mitigated -> monitoring. Duration: ~32m. p99 peak 6.2s -> baseline 420ms.

Samir K: final note: temporary DB pool bump reverted to safe level 300 after stabilization; kept cache enabled. Will schedule capacity increase with SRE.
